title: Fppf hypercovers of algebraic spaces
statement: Let S be a scheme and X an algebraic space over S [def-trf-algebraic-space]. A space map is fppf when it is flat and locally finitely presented in the existing etale-chart sense [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties] and its singleton family is jointly surjective on field-valued point classes [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family]. An augmented simplicial algebraic space over X is a simplicial object U in the slice over X [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Define IsSpaceFppfHypercover(U) to mean that for every n≥0 there are a slice object M and a proper-face matching arrow μ:U_n→M [def-sfb-proper-face-matching-arrow] whose underlying space map is fppf. In degree zero M is terminal in the slice, hence isomorphic to X, in degree one it is U_0×_X U_0, and in higher degrees it is the finite proper-face boundary limit. The matching-arrow predicate specifies μ by all face projections. Covering maps need not be representable by schemes.
